post.summary: Create a purchase with fraud screening

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: application/json

amount.description: A positive integer representing how much to charge, in the smallest currency unit (eg., 100 to charge $1.00, or 100 to Charge ¥100, a zero decimal currency)

reference.description: Reference of the transaction. Max length 255 characters.

device_id.description: The fraud screening service device fingerprint ID. See the Device ID section below for further details

uid.description: The device identifier such as IMEI in android or identifier for vendor in iOS. Maximum length is 128 characters.

os_type.description: The operating system running on the user's device (relevant for native app only). For example: android, ios, etc

app_version.description: The version of the merchant application which is running on the user's device. Maximum length is 50 characters. For example: '2.0.1'

brand.description: The user's device brand (relevant for native app only). For example: htc, apple, etc

model.description: The model of the user's device (relevant for native app only) Maximum length is 50 characters. For example: 'iPhone X', 'Galaxy 3'.

date_of_birth.description: The customer's date of birth, if available

id.description: The customer record ID in the merchant database, if available

address_2.description: The customer's secondary address line (such as building name)

country.description: The ISO 8166 alpha-3 country code for the customer

existing_customer.description: Indicates if this customer is already in the merchants records or not

created_at.description: The date/time that the customer record was created

home_phone.description: The customer's primary phone number. This can be a mobile number, if a home phone number is not provided. Required field for Forter.

address_1.description: The shipping address primary address line

address_2.description: The shipping address secondary address line (such as building name)

city.description: The shipping address city or suburb

country.description: The ISO 3166 alpha-3 country code for the shipping address

shipping_method.description: One of the following shipping options: low_cost, same_day, overnight, express, international, pickup, other If none of these options apply choose the closest match.

recipients.description: Recipients are only required if the recipient differs from the shipping address, or if the order is being multi-shipped

title.description: The recipient title/salutation (e.g. Mr, Mrs, Dr)

address_2.description: The recipients secondary address line (such as building name)

country.description: The recipients country code - ISO 3166 alpha-3

product_code.description: The product code (base level product code)

sku.description: The product SKU (the stock keeping unit code, for example size/color variants)

description.description: The description of the product. For longer descriptions (greater then 26 chars) truncate item specifics and add the truncated information to the gift_message field

line_total.description: The line total for the product (cost times quantity)

tracking_number.description: The shipping tracking number for this item

gift_message.description: Addendum product description, or gift message

shipping_comments.description: Any comments for shipping of the item

x.description: Custom data for the fraud screening. This is usually agreed upon and configured with the fraud provider. Please discuss using these fields with Support should you require assistance. x may be numerical or a string.

website.description: The URL for the website where the order is being placed.

post.summary: Create a purchase using a wallet

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: application/json

amount.description: A positive integer representing how much to charge, in the smallest currency unit (eg., 100 to charge $1.00, or 100 to Charge ¥100, a zero decimal currency)

reference.description: Reference of the transaction. Max length 255 characters.

test.description: Indicates if this is a test transaction

ecm.description: Specifies the transaction source and type for processing. This value is two digits, the first indicating the source (1 = Mail Order, 2 = Telephone Order, 3 = Internet) and the second indicating the payment type (1 = Single, 2 = Recurring, 3 = Instalment - not commonly supported)

sli.description: The Security Level Indicator for 3DS transactions (from the MPI)

xid.description: The transaction ID (XID) value of a 3D Secure authenticated transaction (from the MPI)

cavv.description: The card holder authentication verification value for a 3D Secure authenticated transaction (from the MPI)

par.description: The Payer Request result for a 3D Secure transaction (from the MPI)

ver.description: The Verification Request result for a 3D Secure transaction (from the MPI)

threeds_version.description: This presents the 3D Secure version used for this transaction. Examples are: '1.0.0', '2.0.0' etc. (from the MPI)

directory_server_txn_id.description: This is the unique identifier for a 3D Secure version 2 transaction. (from the MPI)

card_on_file.description: Indicate if this is a card on file transaction or not. Merchant initiated transactions (eg. recurring or any transaction with auth_reason) will automatically be considered as card on file transaction.

auth_reason.description: Indicate what type of merchant initiated transaction it is. Valid values are: 'cardholder_initiated', 'resubmission', 'delayed_charges', 'reauthorization', 'no_show', 'account_topup', 'unscheduled'. For recurring and installment, please use extra.ecm instead. For incremental auth, please check 'Update an authorization'.

stored_credential_indicator.description: For card on file transaction, indicate if it is the initial transaction to put card on file (tokenize card), or the subsequent transactions to use card that is on file already. Possible values are, "I" for initial and "S" for subsequent.

authorization_tracking_id.description: This is required for all subsequent recurring or instalment transactions. This value can be found from the response from the previous / first recurring / instalment transaction. If not provided for wallet transactions, they will be rejected. Note that not all schemes (namely China UnionPay) return this value, in that case this value is not needed.
